preregistration.note: Written concurrently with running the check below, after resolving the target version via `gh api repos/embeddings-benchmark/mteb/releases/latest`.
preregistration.expectation: catalogs/us-equities/foundation-memory.json records mteb's retained usage as a bare `pip install mteb` (component id foundation-mteb, cited README/release URLs only) plus a reference from evidence/receipts/hf-memory-models-20260921.json to the public MTEB leaderboard as a benchmark citation, not an executed evaluation run. There is no retained receipt that runs `mteb.MTEB(...).run(...)` on this host. The only reproducible re-run is pip install + import + version check at the new pin.
preregistration.criteria: qualified-for-install-only: pip install mteb==2.21.6 succeeds and `import mteb; mteb.__version__ == '2.21.6'`. not_comparable for behavior: no retained functional evaluation receipt exists to reproduce.

acceptance_check_ref: catalogs/us-equities/foundation-memory.json (component id=foundation-mteb, retained usage: "pip install mteb", citing https://github.com/embeddings-benchmark/mteb/releases/tag/2.21.0); no retained native evaluation-run receipt was found by rg over evidence/, blueprints/, catalogs/.

isolation.install: uv venv + uv pip install mteb==2.21.6 into a unit-owned venv; no HF dataset download, model download or benchmark task execution was performed (out of scope: would require downloading external model/eval-set assets beyond this task's bound)

results.install: uv pip install mteb==2.21.6 succeeded, pulling torch 2.14.0, transformers 5.17.0, tokenizers 0.23.2, etc.
results.version_check: `import mteb; mteb.__version__` -> `2.21.6`. Matches the requested pin exactly.

limits: The retained current-pin usage for mteb is a bare install command, not an executed evaluation; this unit reproduced the same bar (install + import) at the new version rather than a functional benchmark run, so there is nothing behaviorally comparable between 2.21.0 and 2.21.6 in this repository's evidence.

Running an actual MTEB task (e.g. a retrieval or STS task on a small model) was out of scope for this check: it would require downloading a Hugging Face model and/or dataset, which is a meaningfully larger and slower operation than the isolation/timeboxing for this unit's other four components, and no such run is retained to reproduce.
No paid API or broker involvement; purely local pip install and import.
